domain_specific_rationale: From a Red Team verification and validation standpoint, CP-024 provides a clean, independent, and tamper-evident verification utility (verify_package.py). By relying solely on Python standard library modules (hashlib, os), it eliminates external supply-chain dependencies that could be subverted. The inclusion of explicit exclusions for self-referential artifacts and deterministic lexicographical sorting of normative content files ensures that any unauthorized modification or corrupted artifact in the specification tree is immediately flagged during CI/CD freeze validation.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-17 (Auditability & Traceability) and CAP-19 (Deterministic Package Verification).
residual_risk: Residual Risk: Hidden files, OS metadata artifacts (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db), or symlinks could potentially cause tree hash calculation discrepancies across different developer OS environments. Required Mitigation: Maintain strict ignore filters in EXCLUDE_FILES within verify_package.py (which already excludes .DS_Store and hidden files starting with .) and enforce symlink resolution policies in the test harness.
